thread:
alyssa: Hey folks — working on a migration guide that covers v1 -> v2 swaps (models + SDK rename). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4387

devon: quick q — are we preserving v1 codeblocks as 'compat examples' or removing them?

maria: keep them as compat examples behind a collapsible notice. Also, we only have Node/Python — can someone add a short Ruby/rails snippet for embeddings?

kevin: note: several embedding aliases change dims (legacy 1024 -> new 1536). Need runtime check + graceful fallback. Also add a metric counter so SRE can alert.

kevin: ruby fallback idea:
```rb
vec = client.embed(model: 'text-embed-2', input: text)
if vec.size != EXPECTED_DIM
  logger.warn('embed dim mismatch')
  metrics.increment('embed.dim_mismatch')
  vec = client.embed(model: 'text-embed-legacy', input: text)
end
```

alyssa: nice — please add that to the embeddings section. I'll write an alias-naming guideline and a short QA checklist.

devon: i'll add SDK import for @redwood/sdk@2.x and show the param rename (invoke -> call) plus a tiny compatibility wrapper. will push a sample-app PR with a smoke test.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4387--docs.redwood.com (expires in 7 days)

maria: for smoke tests, run node snippet against a local mock in CI and add pytest for python. i'll add a GitHub Actions job template.

devon: sample-app PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/943 contains the smoke test and wrapper.

kevin: add troubleshooting FAQ item: "HTTP 422 after swap" -> possible causes: embed dim mismatch, param rename, or auth header differences. include quick curl debug examples.

alyssa: adding a one-paragraph comms blurb for the deprecation email that links to this guide and the smoke-test samples. keeping tone gentle and actionable.

maria: UX note: when we recommend traffic-split dual-run, call out measurement window (recommend >=30min) and p95 latency checks before raising traffic.

alyssa: added telemetry naming (telemetry:docs.migration.v1v2) and example Grafana query for embed.dim_mismatch.

kevin: can you also add a brief script to validate saved vectors in datastore (dim check across the dataset) — ops will love that.

alyssa: good idea — adding a snippet to run a batch validation job and a rollback step for routing policies.

ci-bot: sample-app CI passed for snippet smoke tests (build #2318)

devon: i've pushed the wrapper + ruby snippet; tagging reviewers.
